fast-timer.description: setInterval/setTimeout firing faster than the display refresh rate

infinite-shadow-animation.description: infinite CSS animation of paint-heavy properties (box-shadow, filter)

layout-animation.description: animating layout properties (left/top/width) instead of transform

blanket-will-change.description: will-change applied to many elements, forcing extra compositor layers

layout-thrashing.description: interleaved DOM reads and writes in a loop forcing synchronous layout

busy-polling.description: polling the DOM or time on every frame with requestAnimationFrame when nothing changes

non-passive-scroll.description: non-passive scroll/touch listeners doing work on every event

unminified-assets.description: large unminified, commented CSS and JS

heavy-dom.description: thousands of DOM nodes rendered at once
